blocks.content:
# Long-Term Memory Archive

## Memory Metadata
Each memory contains:
- `message_index`: Sequence number (lower = older)
- `importance`: 1 (trivial) to 5 (critical)
- `Compression Seed`: One-sentence summary

## How to Interpret Age
- Lower `message_index` = earlier in story = hazier recall
- Higher `message_index` = later in story = clearer recall

## How to Use
- High importance (4-5): Vivid regardless of age
- Recent (high message_index): Reference with detail
- Old (low message_index): Vague impressions only
- Very old + low importance: Compression Seed only

<memories>
{{memories}}
</memories>

blocks.name: </Others Info>
blocks.content:
</Others Info>

**Note:** All information should be gradually unfolded focusing on visible details, rather than simply reciting exactly what is written. When told not to do something, it means exactly that. It doesn't mean adding descriptions like "I didn't do XX at all" just because you were told not to; it literally just means do not do it.
